change: Extension writes for the Codex client now land in the Desktop-managed client home (<OPENCODEX_HOME>/codex-client) instead of the real ~/.codex; the other five clients keep their own user-level configs.
reason: Writing the real ~/.codex contradicts the 0.2.24 contract that keeps it read only.
The running service starts with CODEX_HOME=<OPENCODEX_HOME>/codex-client, so MCP entries written into ~/.codex are never read.
commands/extensions.rs hard-coded installed=true, creating ~/.hermes/config.yaml on machines without Hermes.

verification.lib_tests_note: Same 5 failures as baseline 6784f89fe (3 macOS TCP listener fixtures, data_root /private path, system-protected temp path).

extra_hardening: A data root placed directly under the shared system temp parent now yields no managed Codex root, because <parent>/opencodex/home would be shared by every instance on the machine.
not_done: No change to the daily user configuration.
The other five clients still rewrite their user-level config files; comments and key order in those files are not preserved.
